versions.changelog:
english-coach 1.0.0

- Initial release of the english-coach skill based on chunk (语块) teaching methodology.
- Guides English acquisition through natural conversation and real materials, following the Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD) principle.
- Splits and records language chunks from user input, tracking mastery with a structured progress log.
- Provides structure: error feedback, progress overview, and chunk-focused learning suggestions after each session.
- Requires manual invocation by the user; does not actively intercept or initiate dialogues.
